2027 Mazda Mazdaspeed6 Feisty Sedan Comes From Imagination Land With Turbo Inline-Six and AWD
10 photos
Photo: jlord8 / Instagram
The Japanese automaker Mazda may be small compared to both Western and now also Chinese automakers, but to be honest, it remains one of the most beloved ones thanks to its down-to-earth family models and also the sports cars, just like other Japanese brands like Subaru are highly appreciated for the same family values along with their adventure flair and motorsport prowess.
So, this tiny automaker, which also has an important presence in the United States, knows how to win customers and show its heart at the same time – just look at the September sales in America, where one of the big winners was Mazda North American Operations ( MNAO ) with an increase of almost 32%!
This year, Mazda’s highlights include the Mazda3 with a jump of more than 42% or the CX-50 with a rise of almost 20% because, what do you know, people still appreciate affordable passenger cars and locally-produced compact crossover SUVs that look equally at home both on the road as well as the trail behind the backyard!
Alas, the CX-5 is still not up to snuff like last year, and the big CX-70 and CX-90 have started losing traction. How about solutions? No worries, as there are numerous ideas outside of the Mazda premises, including from across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI, on how to get higher deliveries thanks to the members of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators.
For example, some of them would like to see the Mazda5 minivan come back to life, while others like Jim, a virtual artist known as " jlord8 " on social media who loves messing around with all things CGI from the automotive realm, would rather bring back some of the cool large vehicles made in the past by the Japanese automaker.
His initial idea for Mazda was to spring back to life the MX-6 large coupe to attract a trendy crowd that feels that the Ford Mustang is a bit childish with its pony and muscle car allure. Then he took care of the family-oriented affairs, and brought back to life the Mazda6 nameplate, albeit as a station wagon. His unofficial, hypothetical Mazda6 Estate design project was based on the CX-90, albeit lowered, chopped, and also with a substantially lower beltline to get the looks of a new Mazda6 station wagon.
Additionally, he gave us a hint that Mazdaspeed was also on their mind with the lovely gold alloy wheels and the sport tire package. Well, as it turns out, that was a hint and also a preview for what came next: a revival of the large Mazda sedan titled ‘2027 Mazdaspeed6.’ This is a simple one: he took the European Mazda 6e and turned it into an ICE machine, seeing it with “a high-horsepower turbo inline-6 and, of course, AWD .” View this post on Instagram A post shared by Jim (@jlord8)
